notes: Update failures now explain themselves. Releases v1.0.4-v1.0.7 each shipped a different signing key, so phones on those versions could never install anything newer (Android refuses a signing-key switch in place). The updater now says exactly what to do - back up your API key, uninstall once, install the new APK - and failed installs translate Android's raw codes (different signing key, version downgrade) into plain instructions. Same signing key as v1.0.8-v1.0.11: installs directly over those versions, no uninstall. Once you are on this key, every future update installs with one tap, forever.
